'''Yenchara''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]]. In honor of a three-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] holiday known as [[Boonta Eve]], this Hutt created the [[Boonta Speeder Race]] in order to generate more profit on Boonta Eve.<ref name="TBH">{{SW|url=news/the-best-holidays-and-celebrations-in-the-galaxy-everybodys-invited-of-course|text=The Best Holidays and Celebrations in the Galaxy&hellip;and Empire Day, Too|int=The Best Holidays and Celebrations in the Galaxy&hellip;and Empire Day, Too|nolive=1}}</ref>
